result.title: SocraticRepair: Planning-Guided Socratic Tutoring for Program Debugging and Misconception Repair
result.summary: Large language models are increasingly used in computer science education. However, the teaching abilities of even the most powerful LLMs are limited: they tend to reveal the solution prematurely and may lose focus on the learner's current debugging objective. To address this, we introduce SocraticRepair, a planning-guided Socratic tutoring framework for program debugging and miscon- ception repair that adapts prior planning-guided tutoring work (Li et al., 2026b). The framework is instantiated in the Python programming domain by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on synthetic multi-turn tutoring dialogues constructed from four preprocessed programming datasets. The system is evaluated using a predefined set of independent metrics and benchmarked against a general-purpose LLM. The experiments show that SocraticRepair achieves higher scores on stepwise scaffolding and question quality while also substantially reducing premature solution disclosure. The results also identify reliable pedagogical plan generation as an important remaining challenge.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出规划引导的苏格拉底式辅导框架 SocraticRepair，用合成多轮辅导对话微调 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B，用于程序调试与迷思概念修复；实验显示分步脚手架与提问质量得分提高、过早给出解答明显减少，但可靠的教学计划生成仍是未解难题。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「避免过早揭示解答」与规划引导的多轮支架推进，可能与 LVR 的停止决策、答案提前泄露及 latent 状态规划存在概念类比，可供核查其计划生成与终止判断是否可迁移。
